enable_ppp.description: Enable PPP mode. Must be specified before other PPP options.

baudrate.description: Internal control value for data flow (e.g., 14400). Does not change physical serial port speed.

mtu.description: Size of IP packets sent across the serial link. Valid values <= 1500.

special_address.description: The network IP alias for slirp. Must end in 0.

dns_address.description: Alias for the DNS server address.

host_address.description: Alias for the IP address of the host slirp is running on.

enable_keepalive.description: Enable TCP keep-alive probes every minute.

keepalive_interval.description: Interval in seconds for TCP keep-alive probes.
